description: Everything moatshark has on one value investor: its latest 13F (holdings, weights, change from the previous quarter), the overseas stakes a 13F never shows (from regulators in Japan, the UK, the Netherlands, France, Germany and Spain, with estimated values), its US funds' non-US holdings (N-PORT), 5% stake filings, Form 4 purchases since the 13F, and when it usually files.
name: get_manager
title: Get a value investor's holdings
